source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1, 4. Ἡ Σιὼν γλυκὺ μηδαμῶς ἔχουσά τι, ἐν πικρίᾳ διάγει καθ᾿ ἑαντήν οὐ ληπτέον γὰρ τὸ πικραινομένη νῦν ἐπί τινος εἴδους ὀργῆς.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Zion, having nothing sweet at all, lives through bitterness by herself; for one must not take “being embittered” now of some form of anger.
pass_b_english: Zion, having nothing sweet at all, lives through bitterness by herself; for one must not take “being embittered” now of some form of anger.

choices.why: Origen’s fr. 11 turns on the agapan vs philein contrast in Lam 1:2.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.

apparatus.note: Source Greek OCR-noisy; restorations for sense disclosed in translator_notes.
